policy_context.resource_basis: One distinct same-cap exploratory cache-churn trace after the copy-reduction candidate. It removes per-analyzer temporary vector<Unicode> and pointer arrays by inserting the immutable base/user DictUnit entries directly into a local exception-safe Trie, in the same order; the existing public two-vector Trie constructor remains unchanged. Compare descriptively to the exact memory_churn_two_versions_memory_opt workload; record cgroup memory.stat, memory.peak, init times, and PSS, but this remains a one-run, multi-change research comparison, not isolated causal proof, stable latency/memory result, capacity claim, or architecture qualification. Any preflight/runtime/containment failure consumes the profile and is not retried.
policy_context.risk_acceptance_reference: Each four-arm exploratory operation is descriptive only; shared-host pressure, one round per arm and test-scale workloads prohibit causal, qualification or architecture-win claims. ApplyBatch and Upsert call latencies have different units and must not be compared as equivalent tail samples.
